inputs.name: accept_eula
inputs.description: Whether you accept the SQL Server licence terms, and those of the ODBC driver when install_tools is on. Read them first; the circuit won't set SQL Server up unless this is true.

inputs.name: edition
inputs.description: Edition to set up, as MSSQL_PID: "Developer", "EnterpriseDeveloper" or "StandardDeveloper" for non-production use, "Express" for small production databases, "Evaluation" for a 180-day trial, or "Standard", "Enterprise" or "EnterpriseCore", which need a licence you've bought. Changing it restarts SQL Server.

inputs.name: sa_password
inputs.description: Password for the sa login. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_sa_password; it never reaches state or the plan. SQL Server wants 8 to 128 characters from at least three of: capitals, small letters, digits and symbols. Changing it restarts SQL Server.

inputs.name: tcp_port
inputs.description: TCP port SQL Server listens on. Changing it restarts SQL Server.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: IPv4 address SQL Server listens on, such as "127.0.0.1", "10.0.0.5" or "0.0.0.0" for every address. Changing it restarts SQL Server.

inputs.name: memory_limit_mb
inputs.description: Physical memory SQL Server may use, in MB. When null, SQL Server takes 80% of the host's memory. Changing it restarts SQL Server.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: Other mssql-conf settings, as section.name, such as { "sqlagent.enabled" = "true", "filelocation.defaultbackupdir" = "/srv/backup" }. Changing them restarts SQL Server.

inputs.name: install_tools
inputs.description: Install sqlcmd and bcp from mssql-tools18, with the Microsoft ODBC driver they need.
